hook: The CEN/TS 18296-2:2026 technical specification from the European Committee for Standardization improves product safety for children.

sections.voiceover: The CEN/TS 18296-2:2026 technical specification from the European Committee for Standardization improves product safety for children.
Does this European Committee for Standardization document provide enough data for toddlers aged 0-3?
However, the specification offers even more data, including 186 measurements and 14 strength values for older children.
CEN approved this document for a 3-year validity period to standardize European child anthropometric data.
Europe will rely on these 93 measurements for toddlers and 186 for older children until 2029.
